ETF rotation research

I designed a frozen-spec, one-shot out-of-sample validation of U.S. ETF rotation signals.

  • Study design
  • Comparisons
  • Evaluation measures

Study design

Universe
11 sector SPDR ETFs and 31 thematic ETFs.
Data window
January 2010–June 2026.
Validation
A frozen specification and a one-shot out-of-sample test.

What I compared against

I benchmarked the rotation signals against three reference groups:

Buy-and-hold
An equal-weight buy-and-hold portfolio.
Market ETFs
SPY and QQQ.
Randomized rotation
1,000 randomized rotation portfolios.

Evaluation measures

The evaluation used Information Ratio, rolling hit rate, and rank information coefficient.

This page describes the study design, not evidence of outperformance. Performance results are not published here.
